name: thunderbird-skill-cli
description: 面向 Claude Code Skill 的 Thunderbird 原生本地 CLI 与专用扩展 Phase 1 compatibility spike

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:extension
scripts.test:security: npm run build && node --test test/discovery.test.mjs test/auth.test.mjs test/non-mcp.test.mjs test/experiment-handler.test.mjs
scripts.test:extension: npm run build && node --test test/extension.test.mjs test/experiment-handler.test.mjs
scripts.build:plugin: npm run build && npm run package:extension && node scripts/build-plugin.ts
scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate ./build/plugin && claude plugin validate .
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:plugin && npm run audit:package
